definition: For a supplied shared modal Frame F, Knows F p w means p holds at every v accessible from w, using the existing Holds semantics. Reflexive accessibility makes this relation factive. Transitivity validates positive introspection through the existing axiom4_valid theorem. These frame conditions are independent assumptions, not definitional requirements on all subjects. The actual world is a separately selected model world.
note: A mathematical epistemic interpretation of the existing modal frame, not a historical source reading, completeness claim or proof of actual knowledge. It does not identify epistemic accessibility with metaphysical possibility or causal dependence.
